text:
sarah_sales: hey @mike_security — Novacorp wants an external-audit-ready bundle for the POC. They listed: SOC 2 system description, signed pen-test authorization letter, network diagrams/data flow, evidence of encryption/KMS handling, and a short note on hosted vs dedicated. Also asked for pricing impact if we spin a dedicated env for ~2 weeks. Can we pull this together? :wave:
mike_security: thanks — we have a POC checklist here: https://drive.redwood.com/assurance/poc-evidence (read-only). Pen-test letter we can sign but we need a formal scope from sales (targets + allowed scan windows + IPs). For SOC 2 we can provide a redacted report and a system description template. Ill start the pen-test pre-auth flow. :memo:
audit_bot: Ticket created: AUD-2026-058 for Novacorp evidence bundle. Due date: 2026-04-02.
jenn_prod: quick flag — if they expect an on-prem-style network diagram for our private deployment, we need to agree POC topology. Private deployment adds setup work and some costs. @sarah_sales who is the technical contact at Novacorp?
sarah_sales: their contact is emma@novacorp.com. She specifically asked about temporary staging creds and an SFTP for logs. Also they require EU data residency.
tom_engineering: We can provision a 2-week dedicated environment in eu-west1. Needs: allowed IP list, confirmation on SFTP vs syslog forwarder, and KMS key creation. KMS separation for dedicated takes ~3 business days to provision roles and keys. Quick commands well run (for ops): ```sh
redwoodctl env create --name novacorp-poc --region eu-west1 --type dedicated --duration 14d
redwoodctl creds grant --env novacorp-poc --role staging --expires 14d
```
mike_security: Pen-test letter template attached in the drive link. Requirements: signed authorization, allowed-scan-window, list of targets, and NDA for vuln details. If they want full internal diagrams we will redact internal hostnames/IP ranges. For SOC 2 we will provide SOC2-Abridged-Redacted.pdf.
sarah_sales: Ill send scope + initial IP list to @mike_security and emma by EOD. Anything else mandatory we should include before we hand to the customer? Also need a quick estimate for dedicated pricing so procurement can pre-approve.
jenn_prod: Ballpark numbers: 2-week dedicated small pool (4x A100-equivalent) ~= $5,000 all-in (infrastructure + support). If they want Private/VPC deployment add one-time setup of ~$7,000 for networking/KMS config. Ill drop a spreadsheet link with line items after this thread.
mike_security: :thumbsup: I need Novacorp to sign the pen-test authorization template before any scans. Tagging @audit_bot to create kickoff and reminders.
audit_bot: Reminder scheduled: AUD-2026-058 kickoff meeting 2026-03-31 15:00 UTC.
sarah_sales: great — will share scope and IPs today. Thanks everyone, Ill confirm timeline with Novacorp and post the signed authorization when available. :pray:
